# Skill catalog and router

The catalog is derived from each published `SKILL.md`. The picker name is always derived from `name`; no display-name override is accepted.

## Workflow chain

| Step | Skill | Use it for | Previous stage |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 · routing | `$skill-router` | Choose the next skill from the catalog. | None |
| 1 · alignment | `$grill-with-docs` | Align a fuzzy idea and record decisions. | None |
| 2 · spec | `$to-spec` | Turn aligned decisions into a feature spec. | `$grill-with-docs` |
| 3 · tickets | `$to-tickets` | Break a spec into vertical tickets. | `$to-spec` |
| 4 · implementation | `$implement` | Implement an approved ticket slice. | `$to-tickets` |
| 5 · tdd | `$tdd` | Drive behavior from red-green-refactor. | `$implement` |
| 6 · review | `$code-review` | Review a diff for standards and spec fit. | `$tdd` |
| 80 · alignment | `$grill-with-docs-requiem` | Sharpen plans and record settled decisions. | None |
| 81 · tickets | `$to-issues` | Turn plans into observable GitHub issues. | None |
| 90 · review | `$antimatter-code-quality-review` | Strict code-quality review with adversarial refutation. | None |
| 91 · principles | `$pizza1` | Argue from correctness, not convention. | None |
| 92 · investigation | `$readonly` | Evidence-first read-only investigation. | None |

## Routing rules

1. Honor an explicit `$skill-name` first.
2. Otherwise choose one exact intent phrase from the aliases below; do not route from a generic word alone.
3. If no alias is a clear match, ask for the missing intent instead of guessing.
4. Use the exact kebab-case skill name when proposing the next step. The display name is derived and never authored.

| Skill | Intent aliases | Explicit-only |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `$antimatter-code-quality-review` | “strict code-quality review”, “adversarial review” | no |
| `$code-review` | “review this diff”, “review the branch”, “pre-merge review” | no |
| `$grill-with-docs` | “align this idea”, “design interview”, “pressure-test the plan” | yes |
| `$grill-with-docs-requiem` | “batch design questions”, “record settled decisions” | yes |
| `$implement` | “implement the spec”, “build from the tickets”, “start the implementation” | yes |
| `$pizza1` | “argue from correctness”, “challenge convention” | no |
| `$readonly` | “read-only investigation”, “prove this without changing anything” | yes |
| `$skill-router` | “which skill should I use”, “route this task”, “what should I use next” | no |
| `$tdd` | “test-driven development”, “red green refactor”, “write the test first” | no |
| `$to-issues` | “publish GitHub issues”, “turn a plan into issues” | no |
| `$to-spec` | “write a feature spec”, “turn this into a spec”, “synthesize the spec” | yes |
| `$to-tickets` | “break this into vertical tickets”, “tracer-bullet tickets”, “split the spec into tickets” | yes |
